name: Southern Shore Cloud Seal (Nam Phố Vân Ấn)
lore: A mulberry-wood seal cut by the founder Nghiêm Họa Đống, with a cloud on its face that she carved from the first morning she painted on the southern shore. Every talisman Nam Phố sells is stamped with it. The hall says a talisman without the cloud is not theirs.
build_use: Talisman damage and speed, and a reward for laying paper early in a long fight.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Painted Beam Banner (Họa Đống Kỳ)
lore: A long silk banner painted with a beam of the founders' hall, flown over the scribes when they paint the clouds at dawn. Ôn Châu Liêm painted it, and it passed to his disciple Kha Triêu Phi. It is the one piece of the dusk line the hall still has.
build_use: Faster Wood arts and heavier Wood stacks for a scribe who lays paper and waits.

name: Dawn Cloud Brush (Triêu Vân Bút)
lore: The founder's morning brush, a mulberry stalk tipped with goat hair, used only between first light and sunrise. Nghiêm Họa Đống painted two hundred years of dawns with it.
build_use: The dawn half's hand: talisman damage and speed.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Mulberry-Hemp Robe (Tang Ma Bào)
lore: A plain robe of Tang Ma Thành hemp dyed with mulberry, the same juice she drew her first talisman in. The hall's mistresses have each had one made at home.
build_use: The linh lực a long paper fight needs, and Wood stacks that bind.

name: Dusk Rain Seal (Mộ Vũ Ấn)
lore: Ôn Châu Liêm's evening seal, cut with a curtain of rain on the western hills. The dusk line stamps its washing talismans with it.
build_use: The dusk half's rain: heals and talismans that wash.

name: Maple Scholar's Robe (Phong Lâm Nho Bào)
lore: An examination candidate's blue robe from Phong Lâm Trấn, his grandfather's, worn to three failed examinations before Kha took it to the hall.
